title: ‘Leave her alone’: Man tells wife extended warranty is a ‘scam,’ not to get it at the dealership. Then the dealership worker steps in
summary: A TikTok about a dealership worker's extended-warranty pitch draws mixed reactions in the comments, from 'buy it if the car is expensive' to 'just self-insure.'

assertions.quote: If your car is worth more than $30k and has a lot of tech in it, BUY THE WARRANTY
You are 100% better off saving that $2,000 over the term of your payments and just paying for repairs out of pocket
GAP insurance covers the 'gap' between the car's depreciated value and the original auto loan
Extended warranties do not cover regular maintenance or wear-and-tear damage
it is important to keep your vehicle in compliance with a required maintenance schedule to avoid having your repair claims denied
